import humanize
import typing
import unittest
class TestUpgrade(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_upgrade(self):
        expected_names = [...]; actual_names = [...]; self.assertEqual(sorted(expected_names), sorted(actual_names))
    def test_metric(self):
        self.assertEqual(humanize.metric(1000), '1k')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.metric(1000000), '1M')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.metric(1000000000), '1G')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.scientific(1000000), '1e+06')
    def test_intcomma(self):
        self.assertEqual(humanize.intcomma(1000, 0), '1000')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.intcomma(1234567, 0), '1,234,567')
    def test_naturaldelta_naturalsize_naturaltime(self):
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaldelta(123), '3 minutes')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaldelta(123 * 60), '3 hours')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturalsize(1000 * 1024 * 1024), '976.562500 MiB')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaltime(123), '3 minutes')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaltime(123 * 60 * 60), '3 hours')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaltime(123 * 60 * 60 * 24), '3 days')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaltime(123 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7), '3 weeks')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaltime(123 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7 * 4), '3 months')
        self.assertEqual(humanize.naturaltime(123 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7 * 52), '3 years')
if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
